tom.f: Heads up 3: RateHarbor trial wraps Wednesday. Need final answers on invoicing model + reconciliation before procurement signs. Can someone surface the trial invoice and any ambiguous line items?
leila: I grabbed the sanitized invoice earlier. Main oddity: they show a "session" metric and apply a blended rate for short vs long sequences.
jorge: Blended rate? sounds like bundling tokens+compute. paste it?
leila: here's the snippet we received (anonymized):
```
RATEHARBOR SESSION-SHORT: 15 sessions @ $12/session = $180.00
RATEHARBOR SESSION-LONG: 7 sessions @ $45/session = $315.00
RATEHARBOR EMBEDS: 4,800 vectors @ $0.003/vector = $14.40
RATEHARBOR TOKEN-PACK: 450,000 tokens @ $0.0008/token = $360.00
MISC: regional-eu-surcharge = $9.00
TOTAL = $878.40
```
nina: That "session" concept will be hard to map to our per-token/embedding SKU. Procurement hates opaque bundles.
tom.f: Agreed. @elliot can you explain how you bucket sessions vs token pack?
elliot (RateHarbor): Hi all 3: Great question. Sessions are user-interaction groupings: short < 64 tokens avg, long >= 64 tokens avg. Session pricing is designed for low-overhead chat apps. Token-pack is for bulk batch jobs. We can provide an expanded price CSV with explicit SKU ids and the bucketing logic.
jorge: Do you support PO + Net45? Our standard is Net45 for vendors under $100k.
elliot (RateHarbor): We support PO numbers. Net45 is fine for customers with annual commits >= $25k. Otherwise Net30. We can do Net45 with a small processing fee for smaller deals.
leila: Tax: do you add VAT for EU customers? And do you supply VAT ID field on invoice for automatic reverse charge?
elliot (RateHarbor): Yes 3: EU VAT added unless a VAT ID is provided; we have VAT ID and tax summary fields on invoices.
nina: Reconciliation: our cost system expects a CSV with these fields: invoice_date, sku_id, qty, unit_price, currency, cost_center. Can you output that?
elliot (RateHarbor): Absolutely, we can output a machine-readable CSV and include cost_center as free-text. We also have a billing webhook for real-time usage events to aid reconciliation.
accounting-bot: Note: Vendor risk form pending (https://vendor-portal.redwood.com/risk/RateHarbor). Assigned to @nina and @legal.team. Deadline 5 business days.
tom.f: Two policy items: 1) Will you honor a 12mo commit with stepdown tiers (e.g., higher commit -> deeper discount)? 2) Do you offer invoice credits for unused committed spend?
elliot (RateHarbor): Yes on tiered discounts. Example: 10% off for $50k+ ARR, 18% off for $120k+ ARR, 25% off for $300k+. Commits are monthly invoiced; any under-utilization can be credited as invoice credits at contract year-end (not refundable cash).
leila: Any hard caps to prevent runaway charges? We need soft caps plus notify+block on breach.
elliot (RateHarbor): We provide soft caps + alerting by default. Hard cap (throttle) available but requires signed throttle addendum and may cause 429s.
jorge: Token counting differences are a pain. Will you accept our token counts for billing reconciliation?
elliot (RateHarbor): We use a BPE-like tokenizer. We can provide a tokenization script and sign a reconciliation addendum to accept Redwood's counts if you want that in the contract.
nina: Legal will need SOC2 summary and data residency details for dedicated pools. Also encryption at rest key management.
elliot (RateHarbor): We have SOC2 Type II report and can provide in NDA channel. For Dedicated customers we support KMS integration (customer-managed keys) and can host in eu-west-1 for EU data residency.
tom.f: Great. Next steps: @elliot please upload CSV price sheet with sku_ids, attach tokenization script, and confirm Net45+PO in writing if commit >= $25k. @nina start vendor risk + SOC2 review. If we get CSV by EOD tomorrow I'll run cost sim against last 30 days.
elliot (RateHarbor): Will do 3: I'll upload CSV and script today, and send formal quote showing the tiered commit math.
leila: And add a column in the CSV showing whether a line item is billable toward commit minimums (important).
elliot (RateHarbor): Good call 3: will include "counts_toward_commit" boolean column.
tom.f: Thanks team. If reconciliation addendum is ok we can automate ingestion with our billing pipeline.
nina: tagging: added to finance queue. I'll prod legal for the SOC2 docs.
elliot (RateHarbor): Ping me if you want a live walkthrough of the billing export. Happy to jump on a 20m call.
tom.f: Cool. End of thread.
